Name: Beam.win
Tagline: Run AI agents on one Mac and use its windows on another
Description: Keep your agents and builds running on a Mac mini or Studio. Beam brings their Terminal, browser and other app windows onto the Mac in front of you, each as its own window with a Dock icon and ⌘Tab presence. Encrypted between your Macs. Free to try.

Name: Beam
Tagline: Highly efficient agentic 501B parameter open model
Description: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 501 billion total parameters, 23 billion active, built for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads.

Name: face2social
Tagline: Search By Face. Know Who's Real.
Description: Is this investor, founder, recruiter, or potential business partner who they claim to be? Searching their name might return thousands of results. Searching their face can give you the edge. Upload a photo and face2social searches for matching faces across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, and X. Compare names, check public profile information, spot inconsistencies, and make better-informed decisions about who you're connecting with. Free preview. No match, no charge.

Name: Tori
Tagline: The smartest AI support agent for customer success
Description: Tori AI support agent learns your product in depth from the content you already have, then delivers accurate answers to even the most complex customer questions through a UI you can fully customize.

Name: Framefields
Tagline: Open-source code-first video for AGI era
Topics: Design Tools, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: Framefields is a high-performance, code-first video engine powered by native WebGPU in Node.js. Built for AI agents and engineers, it replaces bulky creative suites with a single npm package: motion graphics, Photoshop-grade VFX, 3D scenes, and audio DSP. Zero Chromium or browser overhead—render deterministic, frame-accurate video and export hardware-accelerated MP4s directly from TypeScript.

Name: Lookout (for Slack)
Tagline: Urgent Slack messages, handled instantly. Powered by Jev.
Description: Using Jev, Lookout watches Slack for time-sensitive messages and takes the action you choose instantly.

Name: Figma Specs
Tagline: A container for your context that lives on the Figma canvas
Description: Figma Specs is a collaborative Markdown document that can live on its own or beside your designs. Embed Figma frames and FigJam diagrams, work through comments with teammates and agents, and pass the full context to coding agents through MCP.

Name: Kai Resolve by Gleap
Tagline: Support that does the digging for you.
Topics: Customer Success, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Kai Resolve is the AI agent for support tickets your docs can't answer. It reads the screen recording, logs, account data and your code, read-only, then answers the customer or escalates with a diagnosis. Confirmed bugs become coding tasks your team reviews.

Name: Wally by Willow
Tagline: Your Scribe agent that learns how you write
Description: Meet Wally, your new Scribe agent in Willow. Chat by voice to draft an email/slack/ prompt, rewrite highlighted text and keep refining it in the same conversation. Wally uses your personal context and learns your writing style as you go back and forth.

Name: croft
Tagline: Data pipelines in TypeScript, on one DuckDB file
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, GitHub, Data & Analytics
Description: croft pulls data from APIs and files, transforms it with SQL or TypeScript, and keeps it fresh on a schedule. It all lives in one DuckDB file, every table gets a generated type, and Claude Code can drive it. Free, open source, no Python.

Name: Quello
Tagline: One place to ask, across everything you already use.
Description: Other tools search your files. Quello understands your work. One workspace for your tools, docs, and knowledge, with every answer backed by citations and a voice agent you can simply talk to. Built on MCP, it carries your full work context into Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, and Perplexity. The context layer every AI has been missing.

Name: walkai-talkai
Tagline: Talk to your AI coding agent over a walkie-talkie
Description: Press PTT on any handheld radio and talk to your AI coding agent, hands-free. walkai-talkai transcribes your voice on your Mac with local Whisper, types the command into Cursor, Claude Code or Antigravity (or calls OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek or Ollama directly), then speaks the answer back over the radio with neural voice, VOX tones and a roger beep. Your radio audio never leaves your Mac. macOS 13+ on Apple Silicon. One-time lifetime license, no subscription.

Name: Switch Lab
Tagline: Hear and type on keyboard switches before you buy them
Description: Buying mechanical keyboard switches is a guessing game. Specs and YouTube videos don't tell you how a switch will sound and feel on your own desk. Switch Lab lets you press 100 switches with real recorded sounds, put them on a 3D keyboard, and swap between them instantly to compare. Filter by type, weight and sound, then test your pick with typing practice and mini games (typing marathon, drum stems, metro typing). No install, works on phone and desktop.

Name: CrawlForge MCP
Tagline: Give your AI agent 31 web tools in one MCP server
Topics: Open Source, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, GitHub
Description: CrawlForge MCP is an open-source MCP server that gives AI agents 31 web tools: scrape, search, crawl, extract structured data, browse in stealth mode, keep a browser session alive across calls and run multi-source research. Add it to Claude Desktop, Claude Code or Cursor with one npx command and your agent reads the live web as clean markdown or JSON. Pay per use from 1 credit a call, and start with 1,000 free credits, no credit card required.

Name: readywhen
Tagline: The senior personal assistant that works inside WhatsApp
Description: readywhen is the senior Personal Assistant that works inside WhatsApp. It has its own phone number, its own computer, and a project board that keeps track of everything on your plate. Call it. Message it. Voice-note it. And it gets real work done.

Name: Own 1
Tagline: Own your data. Own your AI. A mind of your own.
Description: Own 1 is a fanless personal AI computer that runs two local LLMs and eight agents on your desk, from $3,899 with no subscriptions or per-token costs. What’s different: OwnXOS is AI-native, so every agent gets identity, budgets and an audit receipt, plus a wallet for x402 USDC payments. It bursts to OwnXCloud only when you allow it. Nexy, your private AI co-worker, ships on it and orchestrates hundreds of agents. Your data and memory stay local.

Name: Lancetta
Tagline: Know when to push your coding agents, and when to ease off
Topics: Productivity, Artificial Intelligence, Menu Bar Apps
Description: Lancetta is a native macOS menu-bar app that tells you when and how to use Claude Code and Codex. From every quota reading it says what to do next: spend a window about to reset unused, slow down before an agent stops, move to the other agent while it has room. It checks what your agents load at every start, frees the background processes they leave behind, and keeps every session on one wall, the ones waiting on you first. Reading quota spends zero tokens. Free, signed, macOS 15+.

Name: Lazy AWS
Tagline: A keyboard-driven home for your AWS resources
Topics: Amazon, Open Source, Developer Tools, GitHub
Description: Your AWS resources. One terminal. Browse, inspect, and run confirmed AWS CLI actions without leaving your keyboard.

Name: buddylist
Tagline: Chat with your coding agents like it's 2005
Description: A free desktop app for macOS (Apple Silicon), Windows and Linux that puts Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and OpenCode in an MSN-style buddy list. Use separate Git worktrees for separate jobs, or group-chat agents in a shared folder. Let them take turns, answer together or hand unfinished tasks to another agent. Review diffs, run terminals, preview your app and track PR checks beside the chat. Bring your own agent accounts; provider access and usage are separate.

Name: CoolDock
Tagline: A smart second Dock for your Mac with 160+ live widgets.
Description: Add live widgets, quick actions, apps, folders, search, stats, weather, calendars, reminders, and more into a beautiful second Dock beside your original Mac Dock.
